referenceRole: Style and layout reference only; character and scene must not be reproduced.
sharedPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: printable children's coloring page for MasalNova, A4 portrait. Professional black-and-white children's coloring-book line art matching the reference's friendly visual language; smooth clean closed outlines; consistent medium-bold line weight; large enclosed coloring areas. One clear central scene, full subjects visible, generous blank outer margins, every object fully inside frame. Audience: children ages 4 to 7. Pure black outlines on pure white, white interior fills, readable hands and faces, anatomically coherent, no text, logo, watermark or border. Avoid Keloğlan, bald boy, pointed felt cap, color, gray, shadows, gradients, cross-hatching, sketch texture, double outlines, tiny details, solid black areas except pupils, photorealism, cropped objects, crowded backgrounds and copyrighted character styling.
